Name: SVE Nexus Warp For Custom Farms
Author: sexynes
Description:
[size=3]This mod automatically sets Stardew Valley Expanded Nexus Warp at the custom farm's warp totem. To unlock the Nexus Warp, the farm warp at the Enchanted Grove must be unlocked, and required cutscenes must have been seen. 

If the farm warp at the Enchanted Grove has not activated despite fulfilling SVE's requirements, one can select Debug in the config, and the Nexus Warp may activate. To manually configure the coordinates of the Nexus Warp, deactivate the mod from the config, and use SVE's config.

If using a farm from SVE (Frontier Farm, Grandpa's Farm, and Immersive Farm 2 Remastered), this mod will not apply because their Nexus Warp is already set. [/size]
